name: 91. Streaming raw_response retains every provider SSE frame (#7144) (raw-stream-frames)
description:
Issue #7144: with send_back_raw_response enabled, the OpenAI-compatible chat streaming
loop attached ExtraFields.RawResponse only inside the branch that forwards chunks
carrying content/reasoning/audio/tool calls. Role-only, finish-only and usage-only
frames are documented parts of an OpenAI stream, but none of them reaches that branch,
so their bytes were discarded before framework/streaming could reconstruct
raw_response - which it does purely by concatenating chunk.RawResponse. The usage-only
frame is the provider's authoritative token count and is what Bifrost bills from, so
the captured audit trail could not be reconciled against a provider invoice.

The mirror defect lived on the Responses-over-Chat fallback, where one upstream chat
frame spreads into several Responses events and each was stamped with the same payload,
making a single frame appear N times.

91.1 pins the usage-only frame surviving on the direct chat path, and that Bifrost still
reports normalized usage (proving the frame is read, not merely recorded).
91.2 pins the finish-only frame surviving, captured exactly once.
91.3 pins the fallback path no longer duplicating frames.

The refusal/annotation forwarding fix from the same change is not pinned here: a live
model cannot be reliably made to emit delta.refusal, so it is covered by the Go tests
TestChatStreamForwardsRefusalOnlyDelta / TestChatStreamForwardsAnnotationOnlyDelta.
